a.xlink:title: Common base for property related ops.
Base class for PIP_ (property in-place) op codes.
Base class for property in-place assign op codes (PIP_ADD, PIP_SUB, etc.).
L_GET PROPERTY, lvalue ; get local property.
L_SET PROPERTY, rvalue ; set local property.
P_GET PROPERTY, rvalue-target, lvalue.
P_REF PROPERTY, rvalue-target, lvalue ; move Ref-to-property to destination.
P_SET PROPERTY, rvalue-target, rvalue.
P_VAR PROPERTY, rvalue-target, lvalue ; move Var-to-property to destination.
Base class for all XVM machine code instructions, each of which is called an "op".
PIP_DEC PROPERTY, rvalue-target ; in-place decrement; no result.
PIP_INC PROPERTY, rvalue-target ; in-place increment; no result.
PIP_DECA PROPERTY, rvalue-target, lvalue ; same as IP_DECA for a register.
PIP_INCA PROPERTY, rvalue-target, lvalue ; same as IP_INCA for a register.
PIP_DECB PROPERTY, rvalue-target, lvalue ; same as IP_DECB for a register.
PIP_INCB PROPERTY, rvalue-target, lvalue ; same as IP_INCB for a register.
PIP_ADD PROPERTY, rvalue-target, rvalue2 ; T += T.
PIP_AND PROPERTY, rvalue-target, rvalue2 ; T &= T.
PIP_DIV PROPERTY, rvalue-target, rvalue2 ; T /= T.
PIP_MOD PROPERTY, rvalue-target, rvalue2 ; T %= T.
PIP_MUL PROPERTY, rvalue-target, rvalue2 ; T *= T.
PIP_OR PROPERTY, rvalue-target, rvalue2 ; T |= T.
PIP_SHL PROPERTY, rvalue-target, rvalue2 ; T <<= T.
PIP_SHR PROPERTY, rvalue-target, rvalue2 ; T >>= T.
PIP_USHR PROPERTY, rvalue-target, rvalue2 ; T >>>= T.
PIP_SUB PROPERTY, rvalue-target, rvalue2 ; T -= T.
PIP_XOR PROPERTY, rvalue-target, rvalue2 ; T ^= T.
